description: This file manages the client-side state and logic for the dashboard in a route and task management application. It includes functions for loading, saving, resetting, and manipulating domain data such as routes, tasks, engineers, and their related metrics and statuses. The code heavily utilizes dummy data imports and provides export functions to compute various metrics, handle task status updates, engineer allocations, and generate detailed summaries for visualization and KPIs.

methods.name: deepClone(obj)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object or array using JSON serialization.

methods.name: nowIso()
methods.description: Returns current timestamp as ISO string.

methods.name: randomId(prefix)
methods.description: Generates a unique string ID with a prefix, random part, and timestamp.

methods.name: clampPct(n)
methods.description: Clamps a number between 0 and 100, rounding to nearest integer; returns 0 if input is not finite.

methods.name: computeRouteCompletion(route)
methods.description: Calculates completion percentage for a route based on planned and completed stops.

methods.name: computeRouteCompletionCriteriaForRoute(route, tasksList)
methods.description: Determines if a route is completed based on waypoint coverage and task completion.

methods.name: getDefaultState()
methods.description: Returns the default initialized state from dummy data, computing route completion info.

methods.name: loadDomainState()
methods.description: Loads state from localStorage or initializes with default dummy data, ensuring shape and backward compatibility.

methods.name: saveDomainState(state)
methods.description: Saves current state to localStorage as JSON string.

methods.name: resetDomainState()
methods.description: Resets state to default dummy data, saves it, and returns the new state.

methods.name: getScopedDomain(state, user)
methods.description: Returns a view of the state filtered by user role and permissions.

methods.name: computeExceptions(tasksList)
methods.description: Counts rejected and redo tasks from a list of tasks.

methods.name: topReasons(tasksList, { limit = 2 } = {})
methods.description: Aggregates top reasons for task rejection or redo from a list of tasks.

methods.name: computeOverallRouteCompletion(routesList)
methods.description: Calculates total planned and completed stops and overall completion percentage for a list of routes.

methods.name: computeRouteStatus(route)
methods.description: Returns a label and tone based on route completion percentage.

methods.name: computeEngineerWorkload(state, { dateIso = "" } = {})
methods.description: Calculates workload metrics for each engineer based on assigned tasks and routes, optionally for a specific date.

methods.name: computeMetrics(scopedState)
methods.description: Generates overall task metrics, including status distributions, region-specific stats, and route completion info.

methods.name: datePrefixFromIso(dateIso)
methods.description: Extracts 'YYYY-MM-DD' date prefix from ISO string, defaulting to current date if input missing.

methods.name: computeRouteCompletionSummary(scopedState, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Provides aggregate and per-route completion data, sorted by remaining stops.

methods.name: computeAllocationSummary(fullState, scopedState, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Summarizes engineer allocations, workloads, and unallocated engineers for a given date.

methods.name: computeExceptionsSummary(scopedState, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Provides daily and trend analytics of rejected and redo tasks.

methods.name: selectTasksDueOnDate(scopedState, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Filters tasks scheduled for a specific date.

methods.name: selectTaskCountsByStatus(scopedState, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Counts number of tasks due today by their status (completed, rejected, redo).

methods.name: computeRouteCompletionWithExceptionsSummary( scopedState, { dateIso, complianceSnapshot = null } = {} )
methods.description: Provides per-route completion, exception counts, and non-compliance severity info for a given date.

methods.name: computeRouteCompletionMinimalMetrics(scopedState)
methods.description: Calculates count of completed and remaining routes, overall percentage for simplified dashboard.

methods.name: computeRouteCompletionOnlySummary(scopedState, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Alias to computeRouteCompletionSummary, used for completion-only dashboards.

methods.name: computeDprSnapshot(state, user, { dateIso } = {})
methods.description: Gathers key metrics for Daily Progress Report (DPR) for a specific date.

methods.name: safeReadJsonLocalStorage(key)
methods.description: Safely reads and parses a JSON value from localStorage.

methods.name: safeWriteJsonLocalStorage(key, value)
methods.description: Safely serializes and writes a JSON object to localStorage.

methods.name: isValidLatLng(lat, lng)
methods.description: Checks if latitude and longitude are within valid ranges.

methods.name: minutesBetweenIso(aIso, bIso)
methods.description: Calculates the absolute difference in minutes between two ISO timestamp strings.

methods.name: computeEngineerAllocationSummary( scopedState, { dateIso = "", complianceSnapshot = null, persistTrend = true, gpsStaleMinutes = 5 } = {} )
methods.description: Analyzes current engineer locations, assignments, tasks, and compliance flags for allocation KPIs with trend indicator.

methods.name: selectEngineerAllocationCounts(scopedState, { dateIso = "" } = {})
methods.description: Summarizes total engineers, active, and inactive counts for dashboard display.

methods.name: updateTaskStatus(state, { taskId, toStatus, reason, actorUserId })
methods.description: Updates the status of a task, records a history entry, and persists state.

methods.name: allocateEngineerToRoute(state, { engineerId, routeId })
methods.description: Assigns or unassigns an engineer to a route, updating the state and saving.

methods.name: computeDpr(state, user, { dateIso })
methods.description: Generates key metrics and details for daily progress report, including tasks, routes, and engineer performance for a date.
